# United Kingdom Last Will and Testament

> A will-drafting documentation instrument for **England and Wales**. The person preparing a will records the testator, the estate, the executors, the beneficiaries and their shares, guardians for children under 18, funeral wishes, and how the will is to be signed and witnessed. The engine checks the record against the **Wills Act 1837** formalities and basic completeness, and tells the person whether the will looks ready to sign.
